programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Barcelona" - "Levante"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Bundesliga. "St. Pauli" - "Werder"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Fenerbahce" - "Partizan"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Virtus" - "Barcelona"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Alaska's Deadliest: Predator Prowl
programme.desc: Alaska's deadliest predators fight to survive in one of America's last wild frontiers. When winter breaks, carnivores clash on Alaska's waterways and wide-open spaces to make the most of the endless sunshine. programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.desc: Cobra. Charmed by some, feared by most, the cobra family is powerful and iconic. From giant cannibalistic king cobras in India to desert specialists that hunt birds in the Kalahari and semi aquatic Forest cobras stalking toads in African swamps.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Since ancient times, humans have had tangled bonds with snakes. Across the Americas and Australia, diverse habitats host venomous vipers and powerful constrictors, each evolved to fill their niche. In the Americas, over 30 rattlesnake species curb rodent populations, sustaining ecosystems. Meanwhile, Australia's coral reefs hide even deadlier sea snakes and the elusive, extremely venomous coastal taipan. From lush forests to desert sands and ocean depths, these continents harbor a hidden world of some of the most lethal, fascinating and secretive serpents.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: British author, television presenter and wildlife expert, Nigel Marven, travels the world to find the deadliest species of snake. In each episode Marven travels to a new country or continent and reveals the top 10 deadliest snakes that inhabit that region. From Costa Rica's black-headed bushmaster to South Africa's infamous black mamba, China's king cobra to Mexico's terciopelo, we uncover the most dangerous snakes on our planet. Known for his bold and impulsive approach to animals in the wild, Marven must be on full alert, as a bite from these slithering serpents could paralyse or even kill him.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Snakes

Sniege įstrigusias transporto priemones gali išvaduoti tik patyrę gelbėtojai, apsiginklavę specialia technika ir prietaisais. programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.desc: Nella the Princess Knight is a British-American animated children's television series that follows adventurous life of fun-loving and fearless princess Nella who turns into a knight when necessary in order to protect her kingdom. Her main treasure is not her crown but her beloved friends- unicorn Trinket, steed Clod and Sir Garrett. Nella sees that no harm comes to her friends and all other citizens of her kingdom. Together with her friends they have fun, solve mysteries and overcome hardships without which life is impossible even in the happiest kingdom.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, their plan soon goes awry when it's discovered that he is the Avatar. programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

Now, Hazel must prove that Cosmo and Wanda are innocent, or else lose them forever. // Frustrated by her mom's split attention between work and home, Hazel wishes to be her assistant to spend more time with her. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: King Me/Private and the Winky Factory King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail? Private and the Winky Factory: Private's favorite treat, the Peanut Butter Winky, is going the way of the dinosaur. Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: La Liga. Madrido „Getafe“ - Sevilijos FC
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Paryžiaus „Saint-Germain“ - Meco FC
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Robin Hood - L'origine della leggenda
programme.desc: Tornato in Inghilterra, Robin di Loxley scopre che il malvagio sceriffo di Nottingham ha preso possesso delle sue proprietà. L'uomo si unisce a una banda di ribelli, in un piano audace per rubare allo sceriffo i suoi soldi e togliergli il potere.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: The Equalizer - Il vendicatore

programme.title: I morti non soffrono
programme.desc: Negli anni 1860, la francocanadese vivace e indipendente Vivienne Le Coudy intraprende un viaggio con l'immigrato danese Holger Olsen, cercando di costruire una vita insieme nella polverosa città di Elk Flats, Nevada.

programme.title: Allied - Un'ombra nascosta
programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2 - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un action nel segno della magia con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Daniel Radcliffe e i premi Oscar Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.title: L'illusione perfetta: Now you see me, now you don't
programme.desc: I 'Quattro cavalieri' e una nuova generazione di illusionisti uniscono le forze per rubare il diamante più grande del mondo a un magnate sudafricano a capo di un'organizzazione criminale internazionale.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La carta più alta
programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: I morti non soffrono
programme.desc: Negli anni 1860, la francocanadese vivace e indipendente Vivienne Le Coudy intraprende un viaggio con l'immigrato danese Holger Olsen, cercando di costruire una vita insieme nella polverosa città di Elk Flats, Nevada.

programme.title: The Equalizer - Il vendicatore
programme.desc: Denzel Washington in un action ispirato alla serie anni '80 "Un giustiziere a New York". Un ex federale torna ad affrontare il crimine per salvare una giovane prostituta.

programme.title: Allied - Un'ombra nascosta
programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.title: Gli anni belli
programme.desc: Maria Grazia Cucinotta e Ninni Bruschetta in una commedia ambientata negli anni 90. Costretta a passare le vacanze nel solito campeggio, la ribelle Elena vivra' un'estate indimenticabile.

programme.title: Drop: Accetta o rifiuta
programme.desc: Una donna accetta un appuntamento romantico, ma la serata sprofonda nell'incubo quando un anonimo criminale comincia a perseguitarla: sul suo smartphone arrivano messaggi sempre piu' minacciosi e un terrificante ricatto a cui lei non puo' sottrarsi.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Face/Off - Due facce di un assassino
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage e John Travolta in un thriller travolgente del maestro John Woo. Con una innovativa tecnica chirurgica, un agente dell'FBI 'indossa' la faccia del terrorista Castor Troy, responsabile di numerosi attentati e finito in coma dopo un incidente. Assumendone l'identita', vuole farsi rivelare dal fratello di Castor il nascondiglio di una bomba micidiale che si annida nel cuore di Los Angeles. Ma quando Castor si risveglia, costringe il chirurgo a trapiantargli la faccia dell'agente creando cosi' uno sbalorditivo rovesciamento di ruoli...

programme.desc: Tom Hardy incarna uno dei personaggi più enigmatici della Marvel. Un parassita entra nel corpo di un giornalista dando vita a un'entità metà umana e metà aliena. Nel cast Michelle Williams.

programme.title: Venom: La furia di Carnage
programme.desc: Tom Hardy, Woody Harrelson e Michelle Williams nel sequel di successo targato Marvel. L'antieroe Venom sfida Carnage, un altro simbionte entrato nel corpo di un serial killer.

programme.title: Il diavolo veste Prada
programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Anne Hathaway in una commedia 'glamour'. Una giornalista viene assunta da una prestigiosa rivista di moda di New York. La dispotica direttrice le rendera' la vita impossibile.

programme.title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
programme.desc: Le ‘Iene’ Luca e Paolo in una commedia con Ricky Memphis e Daniele Liotti. Quattro amici quarantenni tornano a Lisbona per il funerale di Amalia, con cui tutti ebbero una storia ai tempi dell’università, e scoprono che la donna ha messo al mondo un figlio. Chi di loro è il padre?

programme.desc: Nel delta del Mississippi per un vampire movie con Michael B. Jordan e Hailee Steinfeld. 1932: due gemelli afroamericani dal passato travagliato tornano nella città natale per aprire un night club per la comunità nera locale, ma devono affrontare un nemico terrificante.

programme.title: Hypnotic
programme.desc: Ben Affleck e Alice Braga in un thriller di Robert Rodriguez. Aiutato da una sensitiva, un detective scopre che la scomparsa di sua figlia e' collegata a una serie di rapine in banca.

programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins e Brad Pitt in una suggestiva pellicola sull'amore e la morte. Un miliardario accoglie il tenebroso fidanzato della figlia, ma è ignaro della sua vera identità.

programme.title: Enzo
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino in una lucida analisi sul bisogno di trovare un posto nel mondo. Enzo, 16 anni, decide di abbandonare la scuola e una vita agiata per diventare muratore.

programme.title: Il diavolo veste Prada
programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Anne Hathaway in una commedia 'glamour'. Una giornalista viene assunta da una prestigiosa rivista di moda di New York. La dispotica direttrice le rendera' la vita impossibile.

programme.title: Acid
programme.desc: L'angoscia per il cambiamento climatico in un fanta-thriller con Guillaume Canet e Laetitia Dosch. Durante un'anomala ondata di caldo, una perturbazione di pioggia acida e letale minaccia l'Europa, costringendo gli abitanti alla fuga verso una salvezza che appare impossibile.

programme.title: I peccatori
programme.desc: Nel delta del Mississippi per un vampire movie con Michael B. Jordan e Hailee Steinfeld. 1932: due gemelli afroamericani dal passato travagliato tornano nella città natale per aprire un night club per la comunità nera locale, ma devono affrontare un nemico terrificante.

programme.desc: Divertente triangolo amoroso con Geppi Cucciari e il duo comico Luca e Paolo. Un uomo assolda un playboy per indurre in tentazione sua moglie e chiedere finalmente il divorzio.

programme.title: Shark - Il primo squalo
programme.desc: Jason Statham in un action ambientato negli abissi. Un esperto in missioni impossibili deve salvare un team di esploratori da un megalodonte, una specie estinta milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: Al vertice della tensione
programme.desc: Thriller con Ben Affleck e Morgan Freeman nel quarto film basato su Jack Ryan, il personaggio creato da Tom Clancy. Il giovane analista della CIA deve fermare un gruppo di terroristi.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Che bella giornata
programme.desc: Seconda commedia di successo con Checco Zalone. Milano: un ingenuo addetto alla sicurezza del Duomo si lascia ingannare da una terrorista araba e innesca una serie di esilaranti malintesi.

programme.title: La leggenda degli uomini straordinari
programme.desc: L'avventuriero Allan Quatermain (Sean Connery) guida una squadra di eroi della letteratura popolare per fermare il folle piano di Phantom che vuole distruggere il mondo.

programme.title: Lasciarsi un giorno a Roma
programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: Siccita'
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello al film di Paolo Virzi' con un grande cast corale. In una Roma in cui non piove da tre anni, fra divieti e disagi, si incrociano i destini di un gruppo di individui.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Negli Stati Uniti infuocati da una sanguinosa guerra civile, Kirsten Dunst è la coraggiosa fotografa Lee che, insieme ad una collega e due giornalisti, intraprende un rischioso viaggio da New York a Washington per intervistare il Presidente.

programme.title: Elisa
programme.desc: Un criminologo segue il caso di Elisa, una donna di 35 anni rinchiusa in prigione da 10 anni per il barbaro omicidio apparentemente immotivato della sorella e per averne bruciato il cadavere. Sostiene di ricordare poco o niente del delitto.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida
programme.desc: Avvincente dramma sul mondo della boxe con Jack Gyllenhaal e Rachel McAdams. Caduto in disgrazia dopo un incidente, un pugile deve tornare sul ring per ottenere la custodia della figlia.

programme.title: Per un pugno di dollari
programme.desc: Sergio Leone dirige Clint Eastwood nel primo capitolo restaurato della trilogia del dollaro. Un pistolero risolve la lotta tra due famiglie di contrabbandieri.

programme.title: Per qualche dollaro in piu'
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo restaurato della trilogia western di Sergio Leone con Clint Eastwood e Gian Maria Volontè. Due pistoleri braccano un bandito messicano sul quale pende una grossa taglia.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: Dante
programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida

programme.title: La teoria del tutto
programme.desc: Oscar a Eddie Redmayne, al fianco di Felicity Jones nel biopic sullo scienziato Stephen Hawking: una vita segnata dalla malattia, dalla scienza e dall'insuperabile amore per la moglie Jane.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Il caso Minamata
programme.desc: Johnny Depp nel biopic Sky Original. 1971: il fotografo Eugene Smith indaga sui casi di avvelenamento in un villaggio giapponese, causati dall'inquinamento delle industrie chimiche.

programme.title: L'assassinio di Jesse James per mano del codardo Robert Ford
programme.desc: Western con Brad Pitt - premiato a Venezia - e Casey Affleck. Inseguito dai cacciatori di taglie, il fuorilegge Jesse James deve guardarsi da un traditore.

programme.title: Dante
programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.title: Reagan: Un Presidente sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid, Penelope Ann Miller e Jon Voight nel biopic che ripercorre la vita privata e politica di Ronald Reagan, Presidente degli Stati Uniti negli anni 80. Dall'infanzia in Illinois, alla carriera hollywoodiana fino al palcoscenico mondiale come capo della Casa Bianca.

programme.title: Limonov
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Emmanuel Carrère, Kirill Serebrennikov dirige un film sulla travolgente vita dello scrittore e politico Eduard Limonov (Ben Whishaw) tra Russia, America ed Europa.

programme.title: Napoli - New York
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores dirige Pierfrancesco Favino in un dramma tratto da un soggetto di Federico Fellini e Tullio Pinelli. Napoli, 1949: con la speranza di ritrovare la sorella, l'orfanella Celestina si imbarca da clandestina con l'amico Carmine su una nave per New York.

programme.title: Lettere da Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Il signore delle formiche
programme.desc: Gianni Amelio dirige Luigi Lo Cascio ed Elio Germano nella pellicola che ricostruisce la vicenda umana del caso Braibanti e il bigottismo dell'Italia degli anni 60.

programme.title: Il Dono Piu' Prezioso
programme.desc: Mandato al campo di Auschwitz, un padre getta dal treno uno dei suoi figli gemelli. Un povero taglialegna raccoglie un pacco caduto nella neve e il piccolo fagotto si rivela essere ciò che aveva atteso con tanta impazienza.

programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Cailee Spaeny nella pellicola di Sofia Coppola che racconta il grande e turbolento amore tra Priscilla Beaulieu e il re del rock and roll Elvis Presley (Jacob Elordi).

programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.

programme.desc: 5 Oscar e Palma d'oro a Cannes alla travolgente commedia di Sean Baker con Mikey Madison e Mark Eydelshteyn. Una spogliarellista di New York sposa il figlio miliardario di un oligarca russo, ma i suoceri inviano i loro sgherri negli Stati Uniti per annullare il matrimonio.

Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Miller's Girl.

programme.desc: Dal regista de "La vita di Adele", un sensuale film di formazione. Un aspirante sceneggiatore torna nella città d'origine per l'estate dove trova vecchi amori e nuovi amici.

Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.desc: A tu per tu con i protagonisti de "La Gioia", diretto da Nicolangelo Gelormini, presentato alle Giornate degli Autori durante la 82esima Mostra Internazionale del Cinema di Venezia nel 2025. Un'occasione per conoscere aneddoti e curiosità dal set.

Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Jennifer Lopez e Anna Kendrick in una romantica commedia corale. Cinque coppie in dolce attesa si preparano alle gioie e alle preoccupazioni del loro futuro da genitori.

programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Jennifer Lopez e Matthew McConaughey. Un'organizzatrice di matrimoni rimane colpita dal fascino di un pediatra, ma scopre che e' il promesso sposo di una sua cliente.

programme.desc: Cameron Diaz, Jennifer Lopez e Anna Kendrick in una romantica commedia corale. Cinque coppie in dolce attesa si preparano alle gioie e alle preoccupazioni del loro futuro da genitori.

Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.desc: Uberto Pasolini dirige un film struggente con James Norton e Daniel Lamont. Affetto da una malattia incurabile, John vuole trovare una famiglia per suo figlio di quattro anni.

programme.title: Eterno visionario
programme.desc: Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Bruni Tedeschi nel biopic che racconta vita e arte di Luigi Pirandello. Il ritratto intimo del grande drammaturgo e la cronaca della sua esistenza, scandita dal rapporto burrascoso con la moglie e dall'amore per una giovane musa.

programme.title: Leonora addio
programme.desc: Paolo Taviani omaggia Pirandello in un film premiato a Berlino. Dopo la morte dello scrittore, un emissario comunale intraprende un viaggio da Roma ad Agrigento per trasportarne le ceneri.

programme.title: La notte più lunga dell'anno
programme.desc: Dramma corale con Ambra Angiolini. Potenza: attorno a un'area di servizio, la notte del solstizio d'inverno diventa il punto di svolta per un politico, una cubista e un gruppo di ragazzi.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: Toccante pellicola di Edoardo Gabbriellini. Dopo un lungo processo e la prigione, Veronica viene scagionata dall'accusa di omicidio. Tornata in liberta', fatica ad avere una vita normale.

programme.title: Gioventù bruciata
programme.desc: Un classico intramontabile che consacrò il mito di James Dean. Nell'America degli anni '50 un gruppo di ragazzi inquieti e tormentati si ribella al mondo degli adulti. Una generazione allo sbando alla ricerca della propria strada, alla ricerca del brivido ogni oltre limite. Golden Globe a Natalie Wood, nel film d'esordio per un allora diciannovenne Dennis Hopper. Uscito nella sale americane a breve distanza dalla morte di James Dean, avvenuta proprio in un incidente stradale il 30 settembre 1955, quando l'attore aveva girato appena tre film.

programme.title: Il pataffio
programme.desc: Commedia ambientata nel Medioevo con Lino Musella, Giorgio Tirabassi, Alessandro Gassmann e Valerio Mastandrea. Un nobile scopre che il suo feudo e' in rovina e abitato da paesani affamati.

programme.title: Contromano
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia di e con Antonio Albanese. Un commerciante milanese escogita un piano per liberarsi di un venditore ambulante senegalese che gli sta facendo concorrenza.

programme.title: (Im)perfetti criminali
programme.desc: Action-comedy Sky Original di Alessio Maria Federici. Quattro guardie giurate progettano un colpo grosso in gioielleria per aiutare uno di loro. Non mancheranno sorprese e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Scemo e più scemo
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e Jeff Daniels nel celebre road movie demenziale firmato dai fratelli Farrelly. Due amici svitati ne combinano di tutti i colori per restituire una valigetta a una donna.

programme.title: I pompieri
programme.desc: Lino Banfi e Massimo Boldi fra incendi e allagamenti, in un mare di risate. Due vigili del fuoco in pensione ritornano in servizio unendosi ai colleghi più giovani della disastrosa squadra 17, il cui caposquadra è affetto da sonnambulismo. Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. Cast arricchito da Christian De Sica, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato e da un cameo di Moana Pozzi.

programme.title: Belli ciao
programme.desc: Il duo comico di successo Pio e Amedeo nella commedia diretta da Gennaro Nunziante. Due amici d'infanzia, separati da scelte diverse, si ritrovano dopo anni fra differenze e sogni in comune.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: La Trama Fenicia
programme.desc: La commedia di Wes Anderson con Benicio Del Toro segue le vicissitudini di un magnate megalomane e di sua figlia, una giovane novizia. In un vortice di colpi di scena e personaggi caricaturali, i due cercano di portare a termine un folle progetto.

programme.title: Il tuttofare
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto è il principe del foro nella commedia di Valerio Attanasio. Un giovane praticante in legge sogna un contratto in un prestigioso studio ma finirà in un mare di guai.

programme.desc: Commedia con Alec Baldwin e Salma Hayek. Dopo una sbronza colossale, due coniugi facoltosi, ma vicini alla bancarotta, mettono a punto un piano disastroso per tornare ricchi.

programme.desc: Paolo Vita e Nunzio Fabrizio Rotondo dirigono e interpretano un'esilarante commedia. In debito con una strozzina, due amici si fingono medium, ma finiscono per evocare due veri fantasmi.

programme.title: Da grande
programme.desc: Renato Pozzetto in una delle sue commedia di maggior successo. Un bambino di otto anni esprime il desiderio di diventare adulto. Il miracolo si avvera e lui diventa un uomo di 40 anni.

programme.title: L'uomo che comprò la luna
programme.desc: Spy-comedy ambientata in Sardegna con Stefano Fresi, Francesco Pannofino e Jacopo Cullin. Due agenti segreti italiani devono scoprire l’identità del fantomatico proprietario della Luna.

programme.desc: Gli YouNuts! dirigono una comedy on the road con Fabio Rovazzi, Lillo, Alessandra Mastronardi e Michela De Rossi. Una app di Car-Sharing riunisce 4 sconosciuti in un viaggio avventuroso.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson e Zac Efron nell'action comedy ispirata alla serie tv anni '90. Mitch e il suo team di bagnini devono sgominare una pericolosa banda di trafficanti di droga.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.desc: La fantasia incontenibile di Tim Burton per l'atteso sequel con Michael Keaton, Winona Ryder, Jenna Ortega e Monica Bellucci. Per salvare la figlia dal regno dei morti, Lydia stringe un patto con il dispettoso Beetlejuice, che a sua volta deve liberarsi dell'ex moglie Delores.

programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.desc: Brian Cox e Lisa Kudrow in una commedia a tinte horror. Una coppia organizza un weekend per presentare i genitori, ma la casa in affitto è infestata da un poltergeist.

But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yi’s magic works, they notice that Everest isn’t looking too hot. In fact, he’s too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help. Out of options, Yi tries to use her magic to send Everest home – until Burnish and his jerboa sidekick, Duchess, reveal that they’ve made over the kids’ rooftop fort into a high-tech HQ, complete with various tech gadgets for the crew and a temperature-controlled chamber for Everest.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: An earth-shaking rumble signals the arrival of a new creature, but Yi and Jin butt heads, each convinced they’re the better team leader. The crew eventually discovers that the massive Sewer Koi is behind the earthquakes, but he’s missing his precious pearl, the key to a magical underground dam. Without it, the sewer’s water levels will rise, threatening to overflow and flood the whole city! It’s going to take a heist to extract the pearl from its display at a local museum, before it’s too late.

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: With the sudden closing of a local candy shop, NaiNai is busy trying to recreate its famous candied fruit. But after a late-night sugar binge in NaiNai’s stash, Peng starts acting strangely. It turns out that he’s possessed by magical creatures! The Minticon are sugar-addicted puffball creatures, who previously lived in the old candy shop. Armed with her violin, Yi commands the creatures out of Peng’s body, winning over the Minticon in the process.

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class
programme.desc: In the mid-1990s in South Korea, three female office co-workers who enroll in English classes in hopes to advance their careers, struggle to expose the corruption inside their company.

programme.title: Memories Of The Sword
programme.desc: 3 warriors pledge to fight against an incompetent king. However, a betrayal occurs leading to the death of one of the warriors. 18 years later, the daughter of the betrayed sets out to get revenge.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Eun-yi is hired as a nanny in an lavish mansion by businessman Hoon and his pregnant wife, Hae-ra. When Eun-yi is seduced by the father of the house, she becomes the unwitting victim in a series of traps laid by the women of the house. Eun-yi must now outwit and escape the vicious family to protect her sanity and her life.

programme.title: Beautiful Audrey
programme.desc: Mi-yeon and her son Ki-hoon run a noodle restaurant. Her daughter, Ji-eun left for her dream. One day, Mi-yeon is diagnosed with a disease. Will this family be able to protect each other?

programme.title: The Unfair
programme.desc: A demonstration against urban renewal project leads to death of a police and a teenage boy. The boy's father, who claims he's innocent, was arrested for the cop's death.

programme.title: Single In Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: Hitman 2
programme.desc: Jun is serializing a new season of webtoon. He receives an e-mail with great storyline thus draws according to it. Terrorism similar to the story occurs and Jun is being suspected...

programme.title: Aespa: World Tour In Cinemas
programme.desc: Witness aespa's first world tour with futuristic stage visuals, high-energy choreography and captivating vocals. Exclusive behind-the-scenes interviews offer a glimpse behind the curtain.

programme.title: Holy Night: Demon Hunter
programme.desc: Seoul falls into chaos as a devil-worshipping cult summons an ancient demon Asmodeus. “Holy Night”, the demon-hunting trio, unleash their power to battle against the cult enforcers and the demon in order to save a possessed girl from Asmodeus.

programme.title: 0.0Mhz
programme.desc: A group of thrill seekers try to prove the existence of ghost by using radio frequency technology inside the notorious haunted asylum.

programme.title: Worst Woman
programme.desc: Eun-hee is an actress with poor acting and she acts in her life. She creates different characters when she dates a man. Eventually, her lies are tangled up and everything is messed up...

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat The Devil'S Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon And The Lost Talisman
programme.desc: Dr. Cheon is a fake exorcist who cannot see or hear any ghosts. One day, a woman comes to Dr. Cheon, asking him to save her possessed younger sister...

programme.title: My Love, My Bride
programme.desc: Youngmin and Miyoung experienced struggles in their marriage soon after the honeymoon period. As they try to sort things out, they learn the true meaning of love.

programme.title: Beautiful Audrey
programme.desc: Mi-yeon and her son Ki-hoon run a noodle restaurant. Her daughter, Ji-eun left for her dream. One day, Mi-yeon is diagnosed with a disease. Will this family be able to protect each other?

programme.title: The Priests
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester.

programme.title: The Fatal Encounter
programme.desc: King Jeongjo, known as “The King of Misfortune”, fights to survive an assassination attempt with the help of his loyal servant, who has a secret connection to the assassin.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: A radio DJ receives a letter written 23 years ago. Through the letter, the story of his first love and friendships of five friends are revealed.

programme.title: Usury Academy
programme.desc: Kang-jin is bullied as the lowest-ranking boy at school with no presence and money. He starts a business on private loans by chance and soon rises to the top of the school hierarchy.

programme.title: It'S Okay
programme.desc: The movie follows In-yong, an ever-optimistic girl who loses her mother in a car accident, struggles to stay strong on her own. As she is kicked out because of her overdue rent, she finds support from her teacher, her classmate and a pharmacist friend to overcome hardship.

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: Based on the true story of a disgraced Korean researcher who claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later.

programme.title: The Beauty Inside Ep3
programme.desc: Top actress Han Se-gye lives with others' appearance one week out of every month. Seo Do-jae is an executive director of an airline company, who suffers from prosopagnosia. The two fall in love eventually.

programme.title: The Beauty Inside Ep4
programme.desc: Top actress Han Se-gye lives with others' appearance one week out of every month. Seo Do-jae is an executive director of an airline company, who suffers from prosopagnosia. The two fall in love eventually.

programme.title: The Con Artists
programme.desc: A wily safecracker is forced to help a mob boss pull off a $150 million heist, but smells a double-cross in the works.

programme.title: The Lost Choices
programme.desc: A young woman who has speech disorder is raped while on her way home. The police do not believe in her. She is frustrated and thus triggers her silent revenge against the world.

programme.title: Crazy Romance
programme.desc: Two co-workers navigate their feelings for each other through a minefield of office gossip and social media.

programme.title: Smugglers
programme.desc: The haenyeos are having trouble with collecting seafood under water because of the newly built factory nearby. To make a living, they started doing smuggling business...

programme.title: Once Again
programme.desc: Woo-seok in his 40's has always dreamt of going back to his high school days when he had the best days of his life. After an accident, he wakes up and finds himself in the year 1997...

programme.title: Villain And Widow
programme.desc: Widow Yeon-ju rents out the second floor of her home to a novelist. The neighbors suspect the novelist’s true identity as he spends an inordinate time whenever he's left home alone….

programme.title: When The Weather Is Fine Ep11
programme.desc: Drained from her life in the city, a young cellist moves to a quiet small town, where she encounters an old friend who helps her heal and remake herself.

programme.title: When The Weather Is Fine Ep12

programme.title: Mr. Zoo: The Missing Vip

programme.title: Mal-Mo-E: The Secret Mission
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation in the 1940s, two men work together to secretly create a dictionary of the Korean language when the language was banned.

programme.title: Boy In The Pool
programme.desc: Seok-young bumps into Woo-ju and they get closer after Woo-ju saves her from drowning. They lost touch after Woo-ju moves to Seoul to be a swimmer. Will they be able to meet again?

programme.title: Tanging Yaman
programme.desc: Three siblings Danny, Art and Grace are now well settled with their respective families, in widely contrasting lifestyles. The one common thing that binds them loosely together is the love that their mother Dolores \"Loleng\" Rosales holds for all of them and her grandchildren, albeit expressed in varying ways and degrees, but always equally nurturing and self-giving. Much as they are held together by her, they are in turn separated by physical distance and the sad legacy left behind by their deceased, erstwhile strong-willed, patriarchal father.

Behind every great love is a great story.

In Seabrook, South Carolina in the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and deeply in love. But when the summer ends, war and duty separate the young couple.

Today, an elderly man visits a nursing home to read from his notebook to a woman whose memory is fading. As he spins a tale of two young lovers with their whole lives before them, his beloved Allie relives a long-ago passion that has never died, an unbreakable bond between two ordinary people rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love.

Based on the novel by Nicholas Sparks, author of A Walk to Remember and Message in a Bottle.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Smallville S2 7
programme.desc: A mysterious woman, Rachel Dunlevy, visits the Kents and claims to be Clark's mother, prompting them to finally tell Clark what happened after they discovered him in the cornfield that fateful day.

programme.title: Smallville S2 8
programme.desc: Clark tests the limits of his powers to save his young telepathic friend, Ryan (recurring guest star RYAN KELLEY), from an evil doctor who wants to control the boy's abilities.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: Taking place 10 years after his heroic defeat of the Kraken, Perseus (Sam Worthington) embarks on a treacherous quest into the underworld to rescue his father, overthrow the Titans and save mankind.

programme.title: The Legend Of Tarzan (2016)
programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

programme.title: King Arthur: Legend Of The Sword
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guy Ritchie brings his dynamic style to the epic fantasy action adventure \"King Arthur: Legend of the Sword.\" Starring Charlie Hunnam in the title role, the film is an iconoclastic take on the classic Excalibur myth, tracing Arthur's journey from the streets to the throne. When the child Arthur's father is murdered, Vortigern (Jude Law), Arthur's uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy...whether he likes it or not.
